title: Granite & Marble Franchise Opportunity
name: KalingaStone, 50 Franchisees, Est'd in 2009, Mumbai HQ
description: KalingaStone is the flagship premium engineered surface brand of Classic Marble Company (CMC), a leading Indian surface solutions group with roots dating back to 1994. - Launched in 2009, it is India’s first engineered surface manufacturing brand and has grown into a market leader in premium surfaces for residential, commercial, and architectural applications. - The brand operates from a 60‑acre, 43.5 million sq. ft. integrated industrial campus with over 200,000 sq. m of manufacturing capacity, 8 state‑of‑the‑art production lines, and a team of 2,100+ professionals, enabling consistent quality, large‑scale output, and reliable supply. - KalingaStone offers one of the largest portfolios in the category across engineered marble, quartz, terrazzo, and porcelain (slim tiles), with 500+ designs and dedicated R&D to continuously improve durability, finish, and performance. - We will not charge any royalty fee to our franchise partners. - Instead, the franchise partners will purchase the products directly from us as part of the franchise business model. - The revenue projections shared for the franchise partners are based on the performance of our existing outlets. Based on our current business model, we estimate an average of 34 customers per month, with each customer purchasing an average of 2 slabs at ₹30,000 per slab, resulting in an average order value (AOV) of ₹60,000 per customer. - The franchise partners need a GST registration.
